in_marathi.name: Dhairyya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhairyya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhairyya is derived from the Sanskrit word dhairya, which means 'courage, fearlessness, and bravery'. This name is associated with the god Indra, who is known for his courage and power.
